RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so sex was not a differentiating factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may reflect poor diversity governance or breach internal public broadcaster hiring guidelines, raising it will not help your case. It would appear legally confused, distract from legitimate concerns, and potentially damage your professional reputation.

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback. Focus on substantive, objective criteria—particularly the stated emphasis on digital media experience versus your five years as deputy news editor. If you suspect any unlawful bias, age is a far more plausible area of inquiry than sex, given the significant difference in career length.
